integrity: A self-contained derivation uses openly credited classical Hilbert spectral and counting results. Finite diagnostics supplement, not replace, proofs. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: No claim of full spectral purity for periods greater than two or asymptotically periodic perturbations; possible extra eigenvalues or singular spectral components. Finite-section limits apply only to fixed positive thresholds. Priority remains qualified by possible historical matrix-Hankel equivalences.
title: Variance universality and signed logarithmic Weyl laws for periodic Hilbert commutators
